tasks.label: run-tests-chooser-1
tasks.command: .venv-2\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest tests.test_ui_marksheet_kicd tests.test_kicd_grading tests.test_cbc_cloud_flow > test_out.txt 2>&1; .venv-2\Scripts\python.exe -c "import ui_marksheet_primary, ui_marksheet_lower, ui_marksheet_pp1, ui_marksheet_pp2, ui_marksheet_playgroup, ui_marksheet_junior, marksheet_chooser, grading_four_level, create_exam_dialog; print('imports ok')" >> test_out.txt 2>&1

tasks.label: run-tests-chooser-2
tasks.command: .venv-2\Scripts\python.exe -c "import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','tests.test_ui_marksheet_kicd','tests.test_kicd_grading','tests.test_cbc_cloud_flow'],capture_output=True,text=True); t=r.stderr[-1800:]; import ui_marksheet_primary, ui_marksheet_lower, ui_marksheet_pp1, ui_marksheet_pp2, ui_marksheet_playgroup, ui_marksheet_junior, marksheet_chooser, grading_four_level, create_exam_dialog; open('res_utf8.txt','w',encoding='utf8').write(t+chr(10)+'imports ok')"

tasks.label: run-tests-chooser-4
tasks.command: $o = & .venv-2\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest tests.test_ui_marksheet_kicd tests.test_kicd_grading tests.test_cbc_cloud_flow 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" } | Select-Object -Last 14; $o += & .venv-2\Scripts\python.exe -c "import ui_marksheet_primary, ui_marksheet_lower, ui_marksheet_pp1, ui_marksheet_pp2, ui_marksheet_playgroup, ui_marksheet_junior, marksheet_chooser, grading_four_level, create_exam_dialog; print('imports ok')" 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" } | Select-Object -Last 4; $o | Out-File -Encoding utf8 res_final.txt
